passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
passages.text: The applicant must be in the age group of 18-59 years. The applicant should be a person with severe or multiple disabilities. The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line.

source.publisher: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (NSAP portal FAQ)
